title: Flexible Mc Modpack
description: Simple, clean and easy to update across versions. Ideal for users who like to customize with their own mods.
body:
## The best modpack for those quickly swapping versions or adding new mods.
This ModPack is built around essential improvements and quality-of-life features
without changing the core feel of the game. Designed to stay simple, clean, and easy to maintain, making it the perfect base modpack for the avarage user to add upon.

✔️ Well optimized

✔️ Shader support

✔️ Only essential mods

✔️ Almost no mod conflicts when adding new mods

✔️ Client sided works on any non modded server

✔️ Easy to update to other versions

**Great for testing new mods for versions you may not have installed or just quickly swaping versions or just for a simple user who dosnt want a hyper modded expirence.**

If you want to suggest a verison we don't currently support or reporting a bug/crash feel free to suggest/report it in my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/YvEzbQxkMx).

_We do not represent or claim to be affiliated with Minecraft, Mojang or Microsoft._
